title: Jefferies Reviews Exposure to Radiant World
summary: Investors in Jefferies Financial Group’s Point Bonita Capital started asking for all their money back last year when it emerged that the fund’s biggest exposure was to collapsing auto supplier First Brands Group. Jefferies is now reviewing its exposure to Radiant World. Katherine Doherty reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Caterpillar Faces Earnings Test After AI Selloff Hits Stock
summary: Caterpillar Inc.’s stock is limping into its earnings report after losing nearly a quarter of its value last month, setting the results up as a test for investors to see if enthusiasm about the company being an artificial intelligence play has gone too far.

title: Treasuries Climb to Start Week on Oil, Bessent’s Yen Pledge
summary: Treasuries are starting the week on an optimistic note, buoyed by tumbling oil prices and assurances that tens of billions of dollars in Japanese currency interventions won’t be funded from sales of US government debt.

title: US Stocks Climb as Focus Shifts Back to Earnings; Chips Slide
summary: US stocks rose into the first trading day of the month as attention turned to this week’s heavy slate of earnings reports.

title: Prysmian Reaches Deal to Buy US Electrical Maker Atkore
summary: Italy’s Prysmian SpA agreed to buy electrical parts manufacturer Atkore Inc. in an all-cash deal, extending a US growth drive focused on the data-center buildout.

title: Stocks Join Bonds Higher as US-Iran Hopes Sink Oil: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street traders lifted stocks and bonds as the latest sign of easing tensions in the Middle East sank oil prices, allaying worries about faster inflation.

title: Palantir Is Stuck in Worst-of-Both-Worlds Bind With AI, Software
summary: It’s been a sobering stretch for Palantir Technologies Inc. shareholders, who have watched their once high-flying positions lose some 40% of their value since the stock hit a peak in November.

title: Amazon Joins Elite List of Stocks to Top $3 Trillion in Value
summary: Amazon.com Inc. surpassed $3 trillion in market value for the first time, becoming only the fifth company to ever reach the milestone.

title: Yen Rises Amid Speculation of More Intervention After US Support
summary: The yen rallied sharply on Monday amid speculation that authorities may have intervened to prop up the currency again after coordinated action between the US and Japan last week.

title: India’s New Stock Closing Auction Sparks Confusion on Debut
summary: India’s new system to discover end-of-day market prices got off to a confusing start, with traders trying to make sense of a spike in the NSE Nifty 50 Index stemming from the shift.

title: Yen Rally Seen Fading as Fed Rate Hikes to Revive Dollar
summary: The yen’s rally following joint US-Japan intervention has likely run its course, according to currency strategists, who say market expectations of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this year are set to support the dollar.

title: Japan’s Use of Fed Repo May Ease Pressure on Treasury Market
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s championing of a Federal Reserve facility Japan can use to boost the yen comes with the benefit of protecting the US bond market from excess sales.

title: Strategy Sells More Bitcoin, Stock as It Pushes on With Overhaul
summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Inc. is plowing ahead with its pivot from relentlessly buying Bitcoin to focusing on shoring up its capital structure by raising its reserve via sales of the token and its own shares.

title: Chile Peso Bonds Face Pressure if Strait of Hormuz Stays Closed
summary: Chile’s peso borrowing costs risk hitting highs for the year in August as the Middle East conflict drags into its sixth month, even as the economy struggles to gain momentum.

title: Nigeria’s Top Bank Offers $1 Billion Shares Held by Bridge Firm
summary: First HoldCo Plc plans to raise about 1.4 trillion naira ($1 billion) through a share sale after the Central Bank of Nigeria gave the nation’s biggest lender approval for the move.

title: US, Japan Warn of More Yen Action If Needed; Oil Falls on US-Iran Optimism |Bloomberg Brief 08/03/26
summary: The yen swings after US and Japanese officials signal they are committed to defending the currency following their first joint intervention in 15 years. Oil falls after President Trump called off military strikes in the Middle East and said US-Iran talks are set to resume. Rebecca Walser of Walser Wealth Management discusses the implications of Fed Chair Warsh mulling changes to the frequency and timing of Fed meetings. Massimo Battaini, CEO of Prysmian, discusses the company's all-cash deal to acquire US electrical parts manufacturer Atkore, in an exclusive interview.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dip Buyers of Stocks Need to Heed the Market’s Warning Signs
summary: The momentum trade just gave investors a taste of the pronounced profit-and-loss swings they can expect if they fail to hedge or diversify, a warning that’s reinforced by growing inflation risks.

title: Gold Holds Gain as Signs of Hormuz Talks Ease Rate Hike Concerns
summary: Gold held on to its first monthly gain since before the Iran war, with tentative signs of talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz lifting hopes that a breakthrough could ease energy-driven inflation.

title: ‘You Can’t Fool the Bond,’ Says BofA’s Cabana on the Fed
summary: Mark Cabana, head of US rates strategy at BofA Global Research, says the Federal Reserve now has a credibility issue as he discusses the bond market’s reaction to last week’s interest rate decision from the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Warsh Does Not Believe in Current Data Sources: Walser
summary: Rebecca Walser of Walser Wealth Management joins Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the implications of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh mulling changes to the frequency and timing of the Fed's policy meetings. (Source: Bloomberg)
